description: This Java interface defines configuration parameters for monitoring loggers, including capacities, maximum log size, duration, and check intervals, along with an enum for default values and config paths.

classes.name: MonitoringLoggerConfigValue
classes.description: Enum providing default configuration values and paths for monitoring logger settings.

methods.name: successCapacity
methods.description: Returns the configured capacity for success logs per category and type.

methods.name: failureCapacity
methods.description: Returns the configured capacity for failure logs per category and type.

methods.name: maxLogSizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum size in bytes allowed for log entries.

methods.name: logDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration logs will remain enabled after activation.

methods.name: loggingActiveCheckInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval at which the system checks if the logging duration has been exceeded.
